card.name: Verbs and pronouns in old narrative prose
card.fires_on: Small grammar words such as "being", "It", "has" and "it" in older encyclopedia-style or historical prose. They often begin a clause about an event, a journey or a publication.

modes.label: Sentence-opening It
modes.description: The word "It" starts a sentence that comments on a historical expedition or work.

modes.description: "being" or "has" appears in a historical passage about publication or a conflict.

card.writes: No clear meaning; it mildly suppresses words like situation and tradition and promotes a few unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It marks little linking words in old-fashioned historical writing, such as accounts of explorers and books.
